sentences.c: What caused the monsoon to migrate?
sentences.cn_source: 是什么导致了季风的迁移呢？

sentences.c: A monsoon is a seasonal wind that can bring in a large amount of rainfall.
sentences.cn_source: 季风是一种季节性的风，它可以带来大量的降雨。

sentences.c: As I said the monsoon migrated itself, so there was less rain in the Sahara.
sentences.cn_source: 就像我说的，季风会自己转移，所以撒哈拉的雨水就少了。

sentences.cn_source: 我们为演讲者引入了片段标识符。

sentences.cn_source: 他突然感到晕厥，心脏也开始悸动。

sentences.cn_source: 一想到飞行我就心情紧张。

sentences.c: It is vitally important that the patch developer is responsive during this period.

sentences.cn_source: 俱乐部对新的想法都表示欢迎。

sentences.c: You eventually become oblivious to the noise.
sentences.cn_source: 你终究会变得不在意吵闹声的。

sentences.c: He drove off, oblivious of the damage he had caused.
sentences.cn_source: 他车开走了，没有注意到他所造成的损害。

sentences.c: She lay motionless where she was, oblivious to pain.
sentences.cn_source: 她一动不动地躺在原地，感觉不到疼痛。

sentences.c: Some areas, because of their soil texture, topographical position, or distance from rivers or groundwater, have virtually no water available to plants, whereas others do.
sentences.cn_source: 有些地区由于土质、地形位置或与河流或地下水的距离，几乎没有水分能提供给植物，而另一些地区则有。

sentences.c: And then, the contour plot will be the topographical map for this graph.
sentences.cn_source: 等高线就像是这幅图的地形图。

sentences.c: That was, and remains, a topographical fact. It was also, eventually, irrelevant.
sentences.cn_source: 如今这在地理环境上仍是事实，但最终与房地产市场毫不相关。

sentences.cn_source: 他的画哪一类也算不上。

sentences.cn_source: 法官们无法决定它属于哪一类别。

sentences.cn_source: 今年该报的发行量已超过了它的主要对手。

sentences.cn_source: 相互竞争的品牌之间往往看不出明显的区别。
